_source: extracted from LiberOS src/features/divination/divination.js HEXAGRAM_NAMES / HEXAGRAM_DESCRIPTIONS / HEXAGRAM_PATTERNS (the author's adapted descriptions), originally derived from archive/yep/LiberReference/script.js lines 918-997.
_lookup: pattern = 6-char binary string; row 6 (top line) is the first character; '1' = yang, '0' = yin. divination.js uses hexagramForPattern(pattern) via HEXAGRAM_PATTERNS.indexOf.

hexagrams.name: The Creative
hexagrams.interpretation: pure yang — the primal force of heaven, the dragon at the threshold of being.

hexagrams.name: The Receptive
hexagrams.interpretation: pure yin — the nurturing power of the earth, the field that receives.

hexagrams.name: Difficulty at the Beginning
hexagrams.interpretation: chaos before creation. the first thread ties itself; do not rush the knot.

hexagrams.name: Youthful Folly
hexagrams.interpretation: the need for a teacher. the well is dark until the rope is thrown.

hexagrams.name: Waiting
hexagrams.interpretation: patience and preparation. the storm passes if you do not walk in it.

hexagrams.name: Conflict
hexagrams.interpretation: tension and opposition. do not meet force with force; meet it with clarity.

hexagrams.name: The Army
hexagrams.interpretation: organised collective action. one heart, many hands, one direction.

hexagrams.name: Holding Together
hexagrams.interpretation: union and mutual support. the seal binds only if the wax is warm.

hexagrams.name: Small Taming
hexagrams.interpretation: gentle restraint. the small leash tames; the great one breaks.

hexagrams.name: Treading
hexagrams.interpretation: careful behaviour. walk on the toes of the dance; one false step and the floor remembers.

hexagrams.name: Peace
hexagrams.interpretation: harmony and prosperity. the gate opens because the keeper is ready.

hexagrams.name: Standstill
hexagrams.interpretation: stagnation and obstruction. wood rots when it cannot move.

hexagrams.name: Fellowship
hexagrams.interpretation: community and shared purpose. the circle is stronger than any spoke.

hexagrams.name: Great Possession
hexagrams.interpretation: abundance and responsibility. the cup overflows; who carries the spillage?

hexagrams.name: Modesty
hexagrams.interpretation: humility and yielding. the mountain hides beneath the hill.

hexagrams.name: Enthusiasm
hexagrams.interpretation: joyful energy. the spring rises without being asked.

hexagrams.name: Following
hexagrams.interpretation: adaptation and moving with the flow. the reed bends; the oak does not.

hexagrams.name: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
hexagrams.interpretation: decay and repair. mend the raft before the river rises.

hexagrams.name: Approach
hexagrams.interpretation: advancement and growth. the tide comes in; bring it something.

hexagrams.name: Contemplation
hexagrams.interpretation: observation and reflection. the watcher sees more than the actor.

hexagrams.name: Biting Through
hexagrams.interpretation: decisive action. the jaw closes; the matter is settled.

hexagrams.name: Grace
hexagrams.interpretation: beauty and adornment. form is the courtesy the soul pays to the world.

hexagrams.name: Splitting Apart
hexagrams.interpretation: disintegration and dissolution. the leaf returns to the loam that made it.

hexagrams.name: Return
hexagrams.interpretation: the turning point. the wheel has come around; step off, or step on.

hexagrams.name: Innocence
hexagrams.interpretation: spontaneity and the unforced path. the unpainted picture is already true.

hexagrams.name: Great Taming
hexagrams.interpretation: holding steady. the great river moves but does not rage.

hexagrams.name: Nourishment
hexagrams.interpretation: sustenance and care. what you feed, grows.

hexagrams.name: Great Preponderance
hexagrams.interpretation: excess and the bending. the bow that is too straight snaps.

hexagrams.name: The Abysmal
hexagrams.interpretation: danger and water. listen for the current beneath the quiet.

hexagrams.name: The Clinging
hexagrams.interpretation: fire and clarity. what burns away is not lost.

hexagrams.name: Influence
hexagrams.interpretation: attraction. the moon draws the tide without touching it.

hexagrams.name: Duration
hexagrams.interpretation: endurance. the stone forgets the river; the river forgets the stone.

hexagrams.name: Retreat
hexagrams.interpretation: withdrawal. the mountain does not chase the cloud.

hexagrams.name: Great Power
hexagrams.interpretation: vigour. the great axle turns because the bearings are true.

hexagrams.name: Progress
hexagrams.interpretation: advancement. the small door opens onto a great room.

hexagrams.name: Darkening of the Light
hexagrams.interpretation: injury and obscuration. the eclipse is brief; the sun remembers.

hexagrams.name: The Family
hexagrams.interpretation: the household. the hearth is the first altar.

hexagrams.name: Opposition
hexagrams.interpretation: polarity. two stones strike; the spark is the third thing.

hexagrams.name: Obstruction
hexagrams.interpretation: difficulty. the river meets the rock and the rock is patient.

hexagrams.name: Deliverance
hexagrams.interpretation: release. the knot undone is not undone — it is remembered as undone.

hexagrams.name: Decrease
hexagrams.interpretation: diminution. to empty is to fill; to fill is to spill.

hexagrams.name: Increase
hexagrams.interpretation: growth. the vine that climbs covers the wall.

hexagrams.name: Breakthrough
hexagrams.interpretation: breakthrough. the spring breaks the ice because the ice forgot to move.

hexagrams.name: Coming to Meet
hexagrams.interpretation: encounter. the meeting at the crossroads.

hexagrams.name: Gathering Together
hexagrams.interpretation: assembly. many small fires make a great warmth.

hexagrams.name: Pushing Upward
hexagrams.interpretation: ascent. the shoot does not hurry; the light is patient.

hexagrams.name: Oppression
hexagrams.interpretation: exhaustion. even the mountain crumbles under its own weight.

hexagrams.name: The Well
hexagrams.interpretation: nourishment. the well does not move; the village comes to it.

hexagrams.name: Revolution
hexagrams.interpretation: change. what was solid becomes air; what was air becomes song.

hexagrams.name: The Cauldron
hexagrams.interpretation: transformation. the cauldron does not boil itself.

hexagrams.name: The Arousing
hexagrams.interpretation: shock. the thunder does not apologise.

hexagrams.name: Keeping Still
hexagrams.interpretation: meditation. the mountain does not think; it knows.

hexagrams.name: Development
hexagrams.interpretation: gradual growth. the bamboo bends first, then rises.

hexagrams.name: The Marrying Maiden
hexagrams.interpretation: the lesser path. the second marriage is the practical one.

hexagrams.name: Abundance
hexagrams.interpretation: fullness. the cup brims but does not spill.

hexagrams.name: The Wanderer
hexagrams.interpretation: the road. the wanderer keeps no hearth but carries the fire.

hexagrams.name: The Gentle
hexagrams.interpretation: softness. the lake yields to the wind; the wind remembers the lake.

hexagrams.name: The Joyous
hexagrams.interpretation: joy. the lake reflects the sky without keeping it.

hexagrams.name: Dispersion
hexagrams.interpretation: dissolution. the salt returns to the sea that gave it.

hexagrams.name: Limitation
hexagrams.interpretation: measure. the cup without a bottom cannot hold.

hexagrams.name: Inner Truth
hexagrams.interpretation: sincerity. the inner and outer meet without negotiation.

hexagrams.name: Small Preponderance
hexagrams.interpretation: excess of the small. the grain of sand is heavier than the wave.

hexagrams.name: After Completion
hexagrams.interpretation: order. the after-state, the slow exhale.

hexagrams.name: Before Completion
hexagrams.interpretation: transition. the before-state, the held breath.
